spob.text: If anyone sees his brother[a] committing a sin that does not lead to death,[b] he should ask God for him, and God will give him life.[c] This applies to those committing sins that do not lead to death. There is also sin that leads to death. I am not saying he should ask God about that.

public_domain_references.web: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
public_domain_references.asv: If any man see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and [God] will give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: not concerning this do I say that he should make request.
public_domain_references.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin [which is] not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

pob.text: All unrighteousness is sin[b][a], and there is sin not leading to death.

spob.text: Every kind of unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin that does not lead to death.

public_domain_references.bsb: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
public_domain_references.web: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
public_domain_references.asv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
public_domain_references.kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

pob.text: We know that everyone who has been born of God does not keep sinning[a]; rather, the one who was born of God keeps him[c][b], and the evil one does not touch him.

spob.text: We know that those who have been born of God do not keep on sinning. Instead, the one who was born of God[a] guards them, and the evil one does not take hold of them to harm them.

public_domain_references.bsb: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
public_domain_references.web: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
public_domain_references.asv: We know that whosoever is begotten of God sinneth not; but he that was begotten of God keepeth himself, and the evil one toucheth him not.
public_domain_references.kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

pob.text: We know that we are from God[b][a], and the whole world lies in the evil one.

spob.text: We know that we are from God. But the whole world lies under the evil one’s power.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
public_domain_references.web: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
public_domain_references.asv: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in the evil one.
public_domain_references.kjv: [And] we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

pob.text: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding so that we may know the True One; and we are in the True One[a], in his Son Jesus the Messiah. This one is the true God and eternal life.

spob.text: We know that the Son of God has come. He has given us understanding so that we may know the True One. We are in the True One—in his Son, Jesus the Messiah. This one is the true God and eternal life.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
public_domain_references.web: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
public_domain_references.asv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, [even] in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
public_domain_references.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, [even] in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

pob.text: Little children[a], guard yourselves from idols.

spob.text: Dear children, be careful to stay away from idols.

public_domain_references.bsb: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
public_domain_references.web: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
public_domain_references.asv: [My] little children, guard yourselves from idols.
public_domain_references.kjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
